Eve (AE): Heads up — NovaHealth SIG asked for question-by-question evidence. Major blockers: Q12 (encryption at rest), Q13 (key rotation), Q21 (HSM/KMS attestation). Need bundle by Fri EOD.
Ashley (Solutions): I can draft answers for Q12/Q13. Want the rotation logs and KMS config. Who can pull logs?
Tom (Eng): I can export Cloud KMS rotation events and the HSM audit bundle. Will sanitize. ETA 18 hours.
Priya (Security): I'll own attestation & mapping. I'll create a spreadsheet linking SIG Qs to artifacts. Also confirm we can provide a non-prod copy.
Eve (AE): Customer insists on sanitized logs only. Please avoid actual tenant IDs.
Tom (Eng): Understood. I'll redact IDs and put on a signed S3 URL. Command I'm using: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key_ring" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName:"Rotate"' --limit 500`
Ben (PS): For POC they want a short demo: rotate a key, show live serving, show audit entry. I can script rotate + smoke test + capture audit. Want me to coordinate run with NovaHealth?
Eve (AE): Yes — schedule a 30-min window. Prefer Tue 10am PT.
Priya (Security): Mapping: Q12 -> storage encryption config + KMS key metadata, Q13 -> rotation policy PDF + rotation logs, Q21 -> HSM cert + attestation doc, Q30 -> SOC2 mapping snippet. I'll attach a README.
Ashley (Solutions): Final bundle checklist: README.txt, sanitized_kms_rotations.json, rotation_policy.pdf, hsm_attestation.pdf, soc2_controls.csv, poc_runbook.md
Tom (Eng): Uploading sanitized_kms_rotations.json to s3://redwood-sig-evidence/novah/sanitized_kms_rotations.json (signed URL will be shared). Found 4 rotates in 90d; last on 2026-03-18T14:02Z.
sig-bot: New attachment uploaded by Priya (Security): /attachments/novah/sig-qmapping-2026-03-21.xlsx 
Priya (Security): Done with mapping spreadsheet and short README linking each file to the SIG question.
Ben (PS): I'll assemble the POC runbook and test script. Will post the runbook and request the Tue slot.
Eve (AE): Awesome. I'll inform NovaHealth we're aiming for Tue and that sanitized artifacts will be delivered before Fri EOD. :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng): Posted signed URL in the bundle once ready.
Priya (Security): I'll sign off on Q12/Q13 once sanitized logs and rotation policy are attached.
Ben (PS): Final note: include a short note about fallback behavior during rotation (zero-downtime plan). Customers like that.
Eve (AE): Good call. Add to README. Thanks team.
